verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://elicit.com/api/mcp, including a ready-to-run `claude mcp add` command. The docs state that all API functionality, such as search and research reports, is exposed through it for Claude Desktop, Claude Code and other MCP clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and detail on authentication and the specific tools it exposes.
